messages:
mira: Heads up — security advisory: automated scan found a cross-account OIDC role with a wildcard audience ("aud": "*") in the trust policy for role 'thirdparty/analytics-ingest'. This can allow tokens issued for other tenants to assume the role. Immediate actions required: tighten trust to specific aud, revoke/blacklist active tokens at the IdP, and rotate any related service principals. 48h SLA. :warning:

sec-bot: iam-audit v0.9 detected the finding at 2026-03-22T15:12Z. Details: role=thirdparty/analytics-ingest, account=partner-361, issue=TrustPolicy.StringLike(aud) == '*'. Risk=high (cross-account token replay).

ashwin: which accounts/roles are impacted beyond that one?

mira: quick list from the scan: partner-361:thirdparty/analytics-ingest, shared-tools:ingest-bridge, prod:external/metrics-relay. Full list attached in the repo scan output: infra/tools/iam-audit/results/2026-03-22/wildcard-aud.json

ashwin: ok starting coordinated audit across prod + staging + partner-361. Running: `./infra/tools/iam-audit/find_wildcard_aud.py --org prod,staging,partner-361` — will push fixes as PRs where we can. ETA 6h.

mira: remediation checklist (action owners below):
1) Update trust policy to require explicit aud values (example trust.json below).
2) Rotate OIDC client secrets / JWKs for the provider and blacklist old tokens where possible.
3) Revoke active sessions on partner side and ask partner to re-auth.
4) Run infra/tools/iam-audit/verify_trust.py to confirm no remaining '*' auds.
5) Post a short incident summary + timeline after containment.

mira: example trust snippet to replace wildcard (replace PROPER_AUD values):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::PARTNERID:oidc-provider/tokens.redwood.com"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "tokens.redwood.com:aud": "https://tokens.redwood.com/oidc/partner-361"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

mira: remediation commands (examples):
- `aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name thirdparty/analytics-ingest --policy-document file://trust.json`
- run `python infra/tools/iam-audit/lockdown_aud.py --role thirdparty/analytics-ingest --aud https://tokens.redwood.com/oidc/partner-361` to automate common fixes
- revoke sessions/keys on the IdP admin console (partner) and rotate JWKs/secrets

jesse: I'll coordinate partner comms and add this to the PagerDuty runbook. Assign me for partner-361.

ops-oncall: I've proactively blocked new assume-role requests from the OIDC provider in prod at the edge (WAF rule) to prevent further abuse. Monitoring for any 403 spikes from ingest pipelines; impact looks low so far.

santiago: can we get a short list of all roles to patch so I can update the Dedicated host policies?

mira: sent list to infra/owners channel and linked PR template: infra/iam/PRs/auto-fix-wildcard-aud. Owners: ashwin (infra), santiago (platform-security), jesse (oncall/partner-comms), mira (sec). Please ack and paste status updates here.

ashwin: ack. starting PRs now, will link them here as they appear.

jesse: partner notified via partner-361 security contact, asked for forced reauth and jwk rotation on their side. They acknowledged.

sec-bot: compliance:auto-pr will open fixes into infra/iam for roles where the audit script can safely patch trust policies. Tagging with severity:high and notify=eng-security.

mira: If you touch any role, run `infra/tools/iam-audit/verify_trust.py --role <role>` and paste the verification output here. If you need help with a role that has complex conditions, ping me directly.

ashwin: first PR created: infra/iam#4823 — locks aud to partner-361 for thirdparty/analytics-ingest. Running verify now.

ops-oncall: monitoring updated, will escalate on any errors or partner service impact.

mira: thanks all. We expect remediation within 48h; if anyone hits blockers, escalate to sec-oncall. I'll prepare a short internal advisory and a follow-up postmortem if we see evidence of misuse. :lock:
